lead.title: Open WebUI discloses 16 CVEs in one batch; OAuth session-hijack flaw rates CVSS 8.1
lead.summary: Sixteen CVEs against Open WebUI 0.6.41–0.11.1 were published on September 9–10, led by CVE-2026-87016 (CVSS 8.1): an OAuth/SCIM identity-confusion bug where a 'sub' claim containing % or _ SQL wildcards can hijack an administrator's session on SQLite-backed deployments. PostgreSQL installs are unaffected. All 16 are fixed in v0.11.1, which shipped August 25 with security details deliberately withheld — anyone self-hosting Open WebUI should upgrade.

top_stories.title: System76 Thelio Mira AI fits 192GB of ECC GDDR7 into a $3,299 consumer desktop
top_stories.summary: Two RTX PRO 6000 workstation GPUs (192GB combined ECC GDDR7 VRAM) in an AM5 consumer chassis, capable of roughly 146B-parameter 4-bit models locally — a direct counter to the GDDR7 shortage-driven price surge.

top_stories.title: n8n patches expression-sandbox escape to worker RCE (CVE-2026-86083) plus two workflow-injection CVEs
top_stories.summary: CVE-2026-86083 (CVSS 7.7) lets an authenticated workflow editor escape the legacy expression sandbox to full Node.js code execution; all three are fixed from 2.38.2 onward, so self-hosted n8n deployments should upgrade.

top_stories.title: Hugging Face rebuilds AUTOMATIC1111 on Gradio Workflows for local image generation
top_stories.summary: A tutorial and workflow that reimplements the classic AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion UI on Gradio Workflows, aimed at local image-generation tooling.

top_stories.title: Mistral and Cloudera partner to bring sovereign, specialized AI to enterprise data
top_stories.summary: Mistral announced a partnership with Cloudera to deliver sovereign, zone-constrained AI built on its open-weight models inside enterprise data environments.

items.title: A unified per-token gating family for on-policy distillation
items.summary: A four-coefficient per-token gating parameterization subsumes EOPD and ToDi, and beats matched single-channel configs on 33 of 36 cells when distilling a Qwen3-32B teacher into a 4B student.

items.title: SenseNova-U1.5: encoder-free 8B unified visual intelligence with open training code
items.summary: An 8B MoT multimodal model that understands, reasons about and generates visual content at native resolutions up to 4K, with training code open-sourced.

items.title: LOCUS: task-aware low-rank post-training that cuts output-token cost
items.summary: LOCUS selects a low-rank adaptation subspace that reduces continuation length by up to 39.84% on Pythia-2.8B and 14.87–17.58% on Qwen2.5-3B with a frozen backbone and native preference objective.

items.title: ZipCodec: ultra-low-frame-rate streaming speech coding on consumer CPUs
items.summary: A streaming neural codec at 6.25 Hz and 0.80 kbps with 160ms latency; the 842M-parameter model substantially outperforms comparable codecs while running in real time on a consumer-grade CPU.

items.title: VikingRAG: token-efficient retrieval over structured documents
items.summary: A directory-aware semantic data manager that cuts structural-context tokens without sacrificing RAG accuracy, reusing agentic retrieval traces as experience edges.

items.title: Nex-N2.5-Pro: Apache-2.0 Qwen3.5-MoE checkpoint refreshed
items.summary: The new Pro checkpoint in the Nex N2.5 line was updated September 11 and is trending strongly on the Hub alongside Nex-N2.5-mini.

items.title: Community NVFP4 quantization of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lands for local runtimes
items.summary: A community NVFP4 quant of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is published; vLLM support for V4.1 remains a set of open, unmerged PRs.

items.title: Stroq: a local action firewall for AI coding agents
items.summary: A local firewall that tracks what an agent reads, taints the session context, and blocks dangerous follow-up actions before they execute.

items.title: Kern Agent: watch your agent think, step by step
items.summary: Open-source observability that introspects each agent action and output instead of treating the model as a black box.

items.title: Gojo: fully on-device dictation and notch tools for macOS
items.summary: Recognizes speech entirely on-device for dictation into any field, plus clipboard, window, file-shelf and media controls in the MacBook notch.

items.title: GoModel: self-hosted AI gateway as a single Go binary
items.summary: An MIT-licensed OpenAI-compatible gateway that exposes Ollama and vLLM behind one endpoint, with budgets, caching, guardrails, load balancing and failover.

items.title: Loudkit: local TTS with native ports in five languages
items.summary: A local text-to-speech engine with 28 voices across 10 languages and voice cloning, shipped as native Python, Swift, Go, Rust and TypeScript ports with no cloud dependency.

items.title: RTX 5090 mod: three 8-pin connectors unlock 900W and 3,400 MHz
items.summary: TecLab removed the 16-pin power header, ran the Blackwell flagship off three standard 8-pin PCIe connectors, and pushed it to 900W — reviving the question of whether high-end GeForce cards need the 16-pin design.

items.title: “Your PC is the solar panel to cloud AI subscriptions”
items.summary: PCWorld argues local NPU/GPU PCs beat recurring token bills, citing NVIDIA PAIR pooling up to 18 home GPUs and AI appliances like Anker MindBase shown at IFA.
